source_consistency_findings.detail: Narrative text states nearly 70%; Figure 1 states 65%. Retained as source inconsistency rather than silently reconciling.
Section 4.1.2 calls elafibranor/seladelpar PPAR agonists, while Figure 9 legend calls them FXR agonists. The inconsistency is flagged in SEA.
Raw text extraction rendered the first weight-loss threshold as >=25%; direct visual inspection of Figure 3 shows >=5%. Figure-derived extraction uses the visual value.

schema_gaps: The LiteratureAtom schema is designed for primary literature and has no dedicated review-synthesis, guideline-recommendation, or secondary-reported-result atom kind; tags plus author_conclusion/other were used without changing the schema.

Several source-reported recommendations and trial summaries lack full primary-study context in this narrative review; they are explicitly tagged secondary_reported_result or secondary_guideline_summary.
extraction_limitations: This is a narrative expert-meeting review rather than a primary study or systematic review; bibliography entries were not atomized.
Trial-level statistics were extracted only when the review supplied sufficient context; no missing denominators, confidence intervals, or adverse-event rates were invented.
Primary studies cited by the review should be separately retrieved before these secondary-reported results are treated as primary-study evidence.
